en: A hand-colored vintage postcard image showing a central square flanked by historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. The main feature is a large stone fountain topped by a statue of a kneeling archer (appearing to be Diana, goddess of the hunt), flanked by animal statues (possibly deer or stags). There are several people in early 20th-century dress around the fountain. The name 'Großenhain' is printed on the upper left, and 'Marktbrunnen' (Market Fountain) on the upper right.
